note: Tuesday A, workplace English（职场英语）: 事 si6 ×3, then one short standup email (read it once). No BBC today. 30–60 sec day-2 update (point → reason → example) — say it aloud before 📜. Hard recall only in tiny sets, stronger skeletons, no new cards. Recap Saturday workplace lines (deadline / flag a delay / recap / feedback). 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: Read once: a short Tuesday standup email (workplace input)

lines.text: Hi team, a quick update from my side.
lines.translation: 大家好，先从我这边做一个简短更新。

lines.text: Yesterday I got set up and started learning the usual workflow.
lines.translation: 昨天我完成了上手，并开始了解平常的流程。

lines.text: Today I will follow one case and write down the steps.
lines.translation: 今天我会跟一个案例，并把步骤记下来。

lines.text: One ask: when you have ten minutes, could you walk me through how this usually works?
lines.translation: 有一个请求：你方便的时候，能否花十分钟带我走一遍这个流程通常是怎么做的？

tasks.prompt: 30–60 seconds, workplace English: a day-2 daily update. Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script. You can use a polite “could you walk me through…?” as the ask at the end.
tasks.script:
Point: Today I am focusing on one process, end to end.
Reason: I want the usual steps clear, so I can help without slowing anyone down.
Example: I will follow one case and write down the steps. If anything is unclear, I will ask: “Would you have ten minutes later to walk me through how this usually works?”

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。

questions.q: Best order for your 30–60 sec day-2 update?
questions.explain: 先说重点，再讲原因，最后举例。

questions.q: “I want to flag early that this may slip” means…
options: you are announcing a possible delay now
you are asking for a pay rise
questions.explain: flag early = 提前说明风险；slip = 可能延期。

questions.q: “Could you walk me through how this usually works?” is for…
options: politely asking a colleague to show you a process
telling someone the work is late
questions.explain: 礼貌请教：请对方带你走一遍通常的做法。

questions.q: “When do you need this by?” is asking for…
questions.explain: 在确认截止时间。反馈是 “what I could do better next time”；收尾复述是 “Just to recap…”。
